description: This file 'VSSTypeSanitizer.cpp' contains implementations for data validation and sanitization functions used within the VSS (Vehicle Signal Specification) context. It includes functions for checking numeric types, boolean, enumerations, and arrays, primarily to ensure data conforms to expected types and bounds before processing or storage.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: A class providing validation and sanitization methods for VSS data types, including checkAndSanitizeType and checkArrayType.

methods.name: void checkNumTypes(jsoncons::json & meta,jsoncons::json & val)
methods.description: Template function that verifies if a JSON value can be converted to a numeric type, ensuring it is within specified bounds and not infinity.

methods.name: void checkBoolType(jsoncons::json & val)
methods.description: Verifies if a JSON value correctly represents a boolean ('true' or 'false') in string form, converting it to actual boolean.

methods.name: void checkEnumType(jsoncons::json & enumDefinition,jsoncons::json & val)
methods.description: Ensures that a JSON value matches one of the permitted enumeration string values.

methods.name: VssDatabase::checkArrayType
methods.description: Validates each element within a JSON array against a specified subdatatype.

methods.name: VssDatabase::checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Main validation method that checks and sanitizes a JSON value based on its datatype, supporting numeric, boolean, string (including enums), and array types.
